subject: Re: Hi from Ulrik @ Encord
text:
Hi Dillon and Alex

Thank you for your patience as I reviewed your material and also socialized some ideas with my colleagues.

While I see the value Encord brings to the table for Enterprises that have to deal with large volumes of incoming multimodal data and use it for model training, most of Cognex's customers prefer to work with smaller datasets and for the ones that have to handle large datasets, we offer in-house solutions that overlap with the functionality that the Encord platform offers (albeit our offering may not be as comprehensive as yours).

For in-house AI model development, we also have alternate solutions we are leveraging including solutions for synthetic data generation. The tools you offer for data and AI model drift with actionable explanations are more generic than our needs in the machine vision space.

At this time, I don't see a compelling fit, but we should leave the door open for the future.

Overall, I want to say good luck with Encord! It's a great space to be in when AI transformation is rampant across enterprises and not all organizations have the infrastructure to support the scale of incoming data. I can see how Encord would be really valuable for many companies.

Best,
Shirin
